assessment.modelSource: Genuine Gemini candidates generated 2026-10-26; summarised in locally archived TestPilot_AI_Comparison_2026-10-26.md and docs/WEEK7_GEMINI_PLAYWRIGHT_EVIDENCE.md
assessment.caveat: These are preliminary explicit-assertion design judgments, not measured AI-test success rates, validated participant scores, or statistical comparisons.

criteria.acceptanceCriterion: Valid unique details create account and JWT
criteria.basis: The archived Gemini sample includes a successful registration/JWT case; manual TP-001 addresses valid registration.

criteria.acceptanceCriterion: missing fields or short password are rejected.
criteria.basis: Archived Gemini designs include missing-field and short-password negatives; manual TP-002 and TP-003 directly address these.

limitations: AI input phone example can fail the backend's Indian mobile validation, confounding a valid-registration case.

The six manual cases additionally specify exactly eight characters, a duplicate-email normalization check, and invalid phone format. Gemini generated four candidates; coverage beyond these two narrow criteria is not established.

criteria.basis: The Gemini approved-doctor candidate described filtering but did not explicitly assert pending/nonapproved doctors are absent; manual TP-011 targets this.

criteria.acceptanceCriterion: an empty list is handled clearly.
criteria.basis: The Gemini empty-catalog candidate did not assert an empty array or clear UI; manual TP-012 explicitly tests an empty catalog.

limitations: Gemini proposed a method-handling case; manual TP-013 covers an invalid doctor ObjectId.
A successful read-only GET 200 probe does not establish approved-only filtering or empty state.

criteria.basis: Gemini AI-001 and manual TP-023 express valid Pending booking; isolated Playwright verifies POST 201 and exactly one record.
Gemini AI-002 addresses an occupied slot and manual TP-026 addresses booked slots. Both do not alone prove all unavailable-time classes.

limitations: Gemini missed out-of-working-hours booking (TP-024) and concurrent-booking collision (TP-025).
The source-derived US-018 concurrency assertion is NOT a Gemini-produced scenario.
Gemini's placeholder doctorId and dated time examples were adapted to valid isolated fixtures; adaptation requires human sign-off.

measuredExecution.source: GitHub Actions Playwright Chromium + isolated generated-case API tests job logs

generatedCaseMappings.assertion: Valid booking creates exactly one Pending appointment
Reserved slot is rejected HTTP 409 without duplicate
Missing mandatory booking fields rejected HTTP 400 with zero inserts
Unauthenticated booking denied HTTP 401 with zero inserts

measuredExecution.disclaimer: This is verified execution of four source-reviewed Gemini scenario intents using fixed test code and synthetic localhost data. It is NOT evidence that the real Gemini input was human-approved in the Lab, nor that arbitrary generated scripts were executed.
